note: State minimum-wage tables (founder decision 5b-D1, 9 Oct 2026). Figures copied from the official notifications named in each set, described in our own words; every set is marked verify until the compliance owner checks it. Loaded through the console flow: drafted by one YukthiX staff member, published by another (scripts/load-min-wages.ts, prisma/seed.ts). States the demo companies use but with no reachable official current source are listed in missing.

missing.why: The UP Labour Department site (uplabour.gov.in, Minimum Wages and Related VDA) publishes VDA orders up to early 2025 only; no in-force 2026 basic rates or VDA for the textile or general employments were reachable. Load when the compliance owner has the current order.
The Hosur plant would follow the food-processing schedule (G.O.(2D) No.73, 10 Sep 2024); not loaded in this batch.

DA is added on top from the average Chennai CPI (Rs 40.18 a month per point over 161, recalculated every 1 April); the current DA amount is not loaded, so checks compare the basic and say so. Special categories (saloons, photo studios and others) are not loaded.
